title: A Man Stood at the Yard's Edge

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The yard kept its days in loaves pushed along a shelf, and a space at the row's end nobody called a number. A man came to the edge and stood with his hands loose. No loaf passed and no slate was shown; the pot said nothing, and the fire kept four pulls and wanted a fifth.
epigraph.attribution: A Low Kiln saying, told of the first working week

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and ninety-nine to four hundred and one days, six months and two hundred and nineteen to two hundred and twenty-one days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust with men unnamed going low into it before first grey, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the soft-cuffed clerk at the out-of-line landing a reported shape brought up the yard by word and never a sighting that makes him a witness. The man who stands at the yard's edge on Ilmen 6 is a shape seen from the basket's low angle with no name, no loaf passed, no slate shown and no word that carries; no interior belongs to him, he is not made a witness and the waiting is never called a sale. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool; the empty place beside it holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth, found where put and still a finding, not a placing; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. Three ordinary tending days in the new year's first working week: the household keeps its days in loaves, glances and an unnamed space at the row's end, no slate is opened within reach of the basket, no figure is given for the boy, and the carried fire from a payer nobody names answers four low pulls with the fifth still missing. The chapter's one meaningful change is planted on Ilmen 6: before first grey three or more men unnamed go low into the back room and Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, and a man from Slate Row whose name is on no roll, with the soft hands of a man who sits at a table and the patient face of a man who can wait in a doorway, stands at the yard's edge with no loaf passed, no slate shown and no word that carries. The boy files the face on a place of its own beside the older record-first hands, never calls the waiting a sale and makes no witness of the men; the promise under the wheel-shed is the betrayal waiting to be called, and neither it nor Tarn's valuable ear is paid. Six answers are filed, 373 through 378; the count reaches 401 exact, six months and two hundred and twenty-one days told by nobody, with the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number and Ilmen 10 three mornings off, unbrought.

scenes.title: What the Fifth Morning Kept
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{399}{Ilmen 5, Y.H. 814, Fifthday}: the small hours opening the first tend-day of the new year's first working week, then first light and the morning under the Vail kiln-house roof. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects only (salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease on the peg, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, twice-mended pot's hairline between old-brass staple and tighter wire, unforged collector sentence at the kindling, uncalled tile debt). Walk-ons only: neighbours going about an ordinary morning in the Clay Yard, keeping the house's arithmetic badly in loaves, glances and a space at the row's end nobody calls a number. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). New day, new date, no recap: nothing from the turn or the three tend-days after it crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and no tend-day is set against a holy day (T071/T072 with T088). Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order and knows a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core, while the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle — both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw in the voice another woman would use for a child who could not hear her, turns them with the back of a broken pot, counts intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 stand behind one unsigned figure — twelve are twelve and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve; the reset supplies no payer to the old twelve or to a new one, and Ilmen 10 (Day 404) stands five mornings off, a reset and not a signing, and is not brought into a morning that has not earned it (T015/T041/T047). The carried fire answers four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its giver without a name for three hundred and ninety-nine days; Garl's name is unspoken the same number and the two stand side by side without becoming one (T088, T009/T013/T092). The keeping at the fold, the three coverings, the river's winter skin and the four rooms with the same gap are found where put and unspent (T097/T060/T086, T083/T085, T081). The file comes out on the towel: answer 373 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the kept things; count 399 exact, six months and two hundred and nineteen days told by nobody. The hand comes down and does not stay.

scenes.title: Six and the Seventh at the Lip
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 5 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 374 and the count standing at 399 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and the cold damper on the afternoon; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours at the kindling and along the yard, passing the price of barley from one end of the wall to the other without making a figure of it. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, called collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no runner came on any road and no ownerless voice came over the boards. New day already dated in Scene 1; nothing crosses forward from the morning as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: Tarn stands at the very end of a term already ended with six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the very edge of its sill; his hand goes over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking, and he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, cutting, counting and spending nothing (T036/T076/T006). The ear-sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it is found where it stopped at the word that would call the loan — a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth stood up — and the Seed 16 breath is unspent, the loan uncalled, the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure and a want he did not voice for a slate with his own name and no mark against it; the warm loft stone stays unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiving, and a term ending is not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom but leaves a man more exposed than it found him (T006 advanced, not paid). The soft-cuffed clerk stays reported set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge with his slate turned inward for an uncalled measure, and Tarn's head does not go toward it again: the degree of Ilmen 3 is held as a shape on its own place, gathered and not repeated as a habit, a rule or a danger come due, and the clerk and the degree are kept with a finger between them (T090/T080, T036/T076/T006 advanced, not paid). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and get no name from him and no word that the room is cold; dusty forearms and clean ones are parted as clot from vessel, he speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and takes it out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time — one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word covering both mercies (T062/T035/T031 advanced, not paid). *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise under the wheel-shed is neither given nor withdrawn while the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, and the four Ash and Slate directions held apart with a finger between every pair, none repeated (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside them; nine record-first hands stand with no tenth and the clerk's reported hand stays on its own tray and the clean-voice speaker stays out of his own sentences, for a clean voice is not a hand; nine stoppings stand with no tenth; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, and three counts in three places stay three (T061/T082, T078, T080). At the going of the light the hearth grammar repeats exactly; the file comes out on the towel and he goes over the field by the place of each thing, leaving every gap a gap; answer 374 filed, count 399 exact, the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number.

scenes.title: Before First Grey
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{400}{Ilmen 6, Y.H. 814, Sixthday}: the small hours opening the day, before first grey, then first light and the morning's work, with answer 375 and the count at 400 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and the back room, Tarn at the kindling; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: three or more men unnamed going low into the back room before first grey, neighbours going about the yard, and a man from Slate Row whose name is on no roll standing at the yard's edge. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, called collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy; Ilmen 10 stands four mornings off and is not brought. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Ilmen 5 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, planted and NOT paid: before first grey three or more men unnamed go low into the room off the wheel-shed with its finger's width of open and its sound of low voices, and Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with the day's meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease where a hand has opened, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; he parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel and asks neither which slate was broken nor whether it was a birth-slate, while the broken ones under the lowest rack stay entered by nobody (T035/T031/T062 advanced, not paid). Then, from the basket's low angle as Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, a man from Slate Row whose name is on no roll stands at the yard's edge with his hands loose at his sides, the soft hands of a man who sits at a table and the patient face of a man who can wait in a doorway; nobody asks him what he wants and he does not say. No loaf is passed, no slate is shown between them, no word carries, no figure is read and no threshold is crossed. The boy files the face on a place of its own beside the older record-first hands — the neat dark hand, Marra's, the finger beneath the shelf, Berr's twice-wiped thumb, Hessa's eighth going up unread, Ilva's ninth with her strip unread, the Drawing collector's ordinary hand, the Kindling collector's ordinary hand, the soft-cuffed clerk's reported hand — and does not make a tenth of the face, does not call the waiting a sale and does not make a witness of the men (T080/T090, T033/T034 held, advanced and not paid). The promise under the wheel-shed goes on gathering against the burned slate at five and the four directions: it is the betrayal waiting to be called, and neither it nor Tarn's valuable ear is paid. The surgeon reads the waiting as a man standing where no work is going on, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder (T060/T086). Sella's hearth grammar holds at the morning's end: fire before basket, coals told the thaw, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening, charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a yard morning is not an opening, seven openings in seven months being seven and not a rule and no eighth made due (T058/T079/T100, T077). The file comes out and the hand comes down on answer 375, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air; count 400 exact, six months and two hundred and twenty days told by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number.

scenes.title: The Face on Its Own Tray
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 6 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 376 and the count standing at 400 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and the cold damper; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: the man from Slate Row at the yard's edge (a shape seen from the basket's low angle, no interior, no second look joined), neighbours at the kindling and the well. No called collector, officer, Berr, Hessa, Ilva, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards. New day already dated in Scene 3; nothing crosses forward from the morning as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the yard goes on in its ordinary grammar while the waiting shape stays at the edge and buys no lesson; the boy refuses to lay it across Jorra's ungiven promise, Tarn's ended term and degree, the twelve arithmetics, the clerk's inward slate, the collector's reason, the clean voice's missing name, the keeping at the fold or the four directions, for likenesses stood up as one would want a payer put under all of them and none stood (T080/T090, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031 advanced, not paid). Tarn takes the broom only after it has been given its instruction, keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, and does not turn his head toward the landing: the degree of Ilmen 3 is a shape found where put and not made a second time, the ear-sentence stops at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath stays unspent, the loan uncalled, the fear of vagrancy and the wanted slate his without a figure (T036/T076/T006 held, advanced and not paid). Jorra keeps the shed's edge, the full note three turns ahead withheld from any High Kiln master who would call it early, the bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word covering both mercies; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name is neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031 advanced, not paid). The burned slate stays at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, and the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions held apart with a finger between every pair and not repeated (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's knock outside them, the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt staying where a thing out of a person must go and not made a seventh; nine record-first hands stand with no tenth, the face at the edge on its tray beside them but not counted among them and the clean-voice speaker not made a tenth of, for a clean voice is not a hand; the three coverings and the river's winter skin are found where put and not spent on a tend-day, the called-gone grey stands beside the left-in-place ridge, the cold foot stays uncured and unnamed and the second chill keeps its withheld cause (T061/T082, T080, T083/T085, T009/T013/T092, T012/T093/T094/T096 held). The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found and knows it costs nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace; under it, louder, the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle and gets none of the three. At the going of the light the hearth grammar repeats exactly; the file comes out on the towel and he goes over the field by the place of each thing, leaving every gap a gap; answer 376 filed, count 400 exact, the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended.

scenes.title: The House Keeps Its Days Badly
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{401}{Ilmen 7, Y.H. 814, Seventhday}: the small hours opening the day, then the morning under the Vail roof, with answer 377 and the count at 401 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours keeping the house's arithmetic badly in loaves pushed along a shelf, glances at the clay jar and an unnamed space at the row's end. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket, no figure given for the boy, and Ilmen 10 three mornings off, unbrought. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Ilmen 6 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the man at the yard's edge is not brought under the roof or made a lesson of. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — crust, fold in the empty place found where put, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, and that a keeping found where put is still a keeping however many hands find it and a finding is not a placing; the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086, T097/T060/T086). The house keeps its days in loaves, glances and a space at the row's end nobody calls a number, while the boy keeps four hundred and one exact against it and does not stand the number up as a threshold, a doctrine or a figure (T071/T072 advanced, not paid). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw and turns them with the back of a broken pot, counts intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and with no figure or handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark hangs where it hung; a morning, a hearth, a shelf and a basket are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, and no eighth is made due on a Seventhday. Twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 stand unchanged behind one unsigned figure with no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve; the printed figure stands unchallenged and the figure read is still not the figure paid, and the finding is not laid across the face at the edge, the promise, the degree or any other kept thing (T015/T041/T047). The carried fire gives four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its giver without a name for four hundred and one days; Garl's name is unspoken the same number and the two stand side by side without becoming one (T088, T009/T013/T092). Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside them on its own place; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the fire's four and a gap under the floor, the boards' four and four and a thumb-width knot or the twelve arithmetics behind one figure, and the three counts in three places stay three (T061/T082, T078). The four rooms with the same gap stay four with a finger between every pair and no Court room brought under the roof as a fifth; the cold foot stays uncured and unnamed and the second chill keeps its withheld cause, carried and not spent (T081, T012/T093/T094/T096 held). The file comes out and the hand comes down on answer 377, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment; count 401 exact, six months and two hundred and twenty-one days told by nobody.

scenes.title: Four Low Pulls and the Face at the Edge
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 7 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 378 and the count at 401 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours settling into the ordinary grammar of the tend; Tarn and Jorra offstage on this last day, their keepings found where put and not made again. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, called collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards — the four old directions stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095 held). New day already dated in Scene 5; the afternoon is not made a boundary, a door, a rule or a payment, and nothing crosses back under the roof from the yard as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payer. Dramatic purpose: at the going of the light the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing and leaves every gap a gap — the crust's gap with its corner standing a hair off the wool, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the told bell's gap in its square beside the heard bell, the silence after the name from Weighing on the gap tray beside the clean voice's missing name, the Long Night story's empty name and the place the Remembering did not fill, the neighbour's called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge at the Vail corner, Tarn's ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan at the very end of a term already ended, Jorra's promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate at the out-of-line landing, Tarn's degree held as a shape and not repeated, and the man from Slate Row's face at the yard's edge on a place of its own. The ledger is checked and unchanged: nine record-first hands with no tenth, the clerk at the landing a reported shape and not a tenth hand and no witness, the face at the edge filed beside the hands and not counted among them and never called a sale; nine stoppings with no tenth and no new stopping made on these three days; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside them on its own place, the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt staying where a thing out of a person must go and not made a seventh; the burned-slate word at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, the four directions held apart with a finger between every pair and not repeated, green a colour and the foundling a shape with no eighth of either and no name given under this roof, the cold foot uncured and unnamed, the cause of the second chill withheld, the river under its winter skin beside water over water, the four rooms with the same gap held apart and the three counts in three places staying three (T080/T090, T061/T082, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T012/T093/T094/T096, T083/T085, T081, T078). The twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 stand behind one unsigned figure with no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve; their twelve true subtractions ride locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road with the key gone up in a coat pocket that never comes back down and the boy having no key. Ilmen 10 stands three mornings off with the year's first arithmetic waiting there, a reset and not a signing, and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; he does not lay his twelve old findings across a new figure to make a row come out even, for a row made even by a hand that has no key is made even on paper and paper is not a payer (T015/T041/T047). Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water under the winter skin, a low thing over a lower thing, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming; the skin is a covering put on by the cold and taken off by the cold, entered nowhere, found where put, not a hearing, not a sign, not a fourth of the three coverings and not spent on a tend-day, and the sound comes from under the covering and not from the covering (T083/T085). The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the note. The inch is not a reach. He takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the covering, lets it go as the note ended — neither early nor stayed — and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Answer 378 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction, the clerk's inward slate, the face at the yard's edge nor the keeping at the fold. Count 401 exact, six months and two hundred and twenty-one days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two standing side by side without becoming one. Six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 373 through 378, and not one is a doctrine; the surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found and knows it costs nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace, while under it, louder, the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread at his mouth wiped and a hand on the pot board's handle and gets none of the three, the wanting and the having-not going on being the work the way a wound goes on being a wound under a dressing that does not close it. Nothing was opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended; no slate lay open within reach of the basket, no figure was given for the boy, no door was drawn across the tend and no payer was set under any of the kept things. The man at the yard's edge stays a shape on its place gathering interest without being called, the promise under the shed stays neither given nor withdrawn, Tarn's degree stays a shape and not a rule, and the house goes on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept — forward.
